answer: Resist Sybils with capped, queued admission: only a small number of new identities may join each epoch, and each newcomer must pass a public maturation window of observed, graded participation before it can trade or vote. A fake army cannot arrive like a comet in one burst; it queues in the open, where a plume of suspicious registrations is easy to spot and challenge. Patient, honest work earns a pearl of standing slowly, so an attacker must fund and sustain thousands of visible, waiting identities for epochs, making a flood slow, expensive, and easy to stop.
